enum HxCheckboxValue_t

Definitions for the checkbox states.

Enumerator:
kHxCheckboxOff  checkbox is not checked
kHxCheckboxOn  checkbox is checked
kHxCheckboxMixed  The checkbox is in a "mixed" state: the checkbox is associated with a group of widgets, with some widgets set and some not set.

Create a checkbox control widget with custom bounds.

This function creates a new checkbox control widget. Might be multi-line.

Parameters:
id IN: Unique ID for the widget, defined by app, or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
pParent IN: Pointer to "parent" widget containing checkbox
pText IN: Text for the checkbox label, or NULL
pBounds IN: Checkbox bounds. Set w to 0 for auto-size
hCheckbox OUT: Handle to the new checkbox; *hCheckbox is NULL on failure
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails, and sets *hCheckbox to NULL.

HxResult HxCheckboxDelete ( HxCheckbox_t *  pCheckbox  ) 

Delete a checkbox control widget.

This function deletes a checkbox created from an earlier call to HxCheckboxNew.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted. HxCheckboxDelete only needs to be called when removing a checkbox at runtime.

Parameters:
pCheckbox IN: Pointer to the checkbox to delete
Returns:
HxResult: HxResult

HxResult HxCheckboxSetValue ( HxCheckbox_t *  pCheckbox,
HxCheckboxValue_t  value 
)

Set the state of a checkbox control widget.

This function sets the state of the checkbox (off or on). Note that it is invalid to set the state to kHxCheckboxMixed, since that state is managed by the toolkit.

NOTE: call to this function will not trigger the kHxCheckboxChanged message. This message is only triggered by the UI interaction

Parameters:
pCheckbox IN: Pointer to a checkbox
value IN: kHxCheckboxOff or kHxCheckboxOn
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if value == kHxCheckboxMixed
